42025.notes: Pennsylvania tax-deed county under the Real Estate Tax Sale Law (RETSL). Carbon County Tax Claim Bureau (Jim Thorpe) runs Upset Sale, Judicial Sale, and Repository Sale tracks — not lien certificates. Judicial Sale (historically following-year November class) is designed to sell free and clear of most private liens when notice is proper. No post-Upset statutory owner redemption; objections to confirmation nisi run on a short court clock. Contact Tax Claim Bureau 570-325-3635 / carbontaxclaim@carboncounty.net. Poconos / Jim Thorpe–Lehighton–Palmerton market — HOA/POA, septic, and flood DD essential.

33001.notes: New Hampshire tax-deed system is municipal, not county-administered. Laconia example: unpaid taxes lien by following March; if unpaid ~2 years and one day from lien date, property may be deeded to the City and sold (historically sealed bid). Barnstead and other towns have used Bid4Assets or local auctioneers for tax-deeded parcels. Research the specific municipality where a parcel sits; do not treat one town's calendar as countywide.
